_comment: Synthetic fixture config for XSPEC-383 R8 — the RED demonstration.
The family is declared by GLOB, not by a list of filenames: a glob is a rule that
keeps matching files nobody has written yet, whereas a filename list stops being
true the moment somebody adds the seventh provider — which is the exact failure
Expected outcome: 6 members, 2 excluded, 3 GREEN, 1 EXEMPT-HONEST, 2 RED, exit 1.
